privileged_info_for_vlm: The form must be titled 'Bird Sighting Entry Form'. It must use the tag 'BirdSighting' for new entries. The required fields are species, location, count, observation_date, habitat, and notes (which maps to the 'text' field in TiddlyWiki). The form must clear inputs upon submission and display a dynamic list of all tiddlers tagged 'BirdSighting'.
